title: A Menswork website has one menu ending in blue admin links, a blue admin section in the footer, and a public yearly Calendar page and Home section

source.ref: Owner asks 2026-10-08: 'Menu should read: Home | The Year | Circles | Calendar | Retreat | About (Blue after this) | ADMIN: Executive Overview', 'Add blue admin section to the footer as well with a link to Executive Overview', 'Add the calendar to the home page without an anchor link. Make the Year Calendar a blue admin link', and the decision card answer 'Public calendar'.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-08. SiteChrome takes one `admin` prop (siteAdminLinks in site-page.tsx): on a skinned site the header menu and the phone menu end with 'Admin:' Executive Overview and Yearly Calendar in the theme's blue, on every page including the /admin pages (which mark the one they are on), and a blue admin section (SiteFooterAdmin in site-admin-bar.tsx) above the footer line adds the labelled 'Manage on Frequency' console link. The admin pages stay gated; the links show for everyone. The separate admin row, its client gate and the readable hint cookie are removed. A Menswork site's `calendar` page (listed in preferences.pages, so the owner orders the menu) and the end of its Home render the admin calendar's look over the Space's published events only (readSitePublicYear in lib/sites/site-admin.ts, through listEventsForSpace's publication gate; no drafts, no gathering notes). The menu labels and removing How it works are Space data (hof-part11 paste). AMENDED 2026-10-08 by LIVE-872 (owner: 'I wanted the Hearts on Fire Frequency calendar on the main home page, not the admin version'): the calendar page and the Home section now render the Space's Frequency calendar, so the probe checks both still render SitePublicCalendar rather than the old markup.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const chrome=r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx');if(!/hs-nav-admin-tag/.test(chrome))miss.push('the menu has no blue admin links');if(!/<SiteFooterAdmin/.test(chrome))miss.push('the footer has no blue admin section');if(!/label: 'Yearly Calendar'/.test(r('components/sites/site-admin-bar.tsx')))miss.push('Yearly Calendar is not an admin link');const page=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');if((page.match(/<SitePublicCalendar/g)||[]).length<2)miss.push('no public calendar page or Home section');if(/includeUnpublished/.test(r('components/sites/site-public-calendar.tsx')))miss.push('the public calendar reads drafts');if(fs.existsSync('components/sites/site-admin-bar-gate.tsx'))miss.push('the old admin row gate is still there');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-869: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
